What prices are not in this list?

These items are in the price file as unconfirmed, so they are not given a dollars-per-second row here.

  • Kling app (kling.ai) consumer subscription prices: pricing not rendered without login/region; check manually
  • Replicate Wan 3.0 '30% off this week' banner: discount not reflected on model page; not applied
  • Replicate Wan 3.0 Prime (alibaba/wan-3-prime): model page shows no static price
  • Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 per-clip credits: plan page only says '~80 Seedance 2.5 videos' for 1,200 credits without clip length/resolution
  • Higgsfield Kling 3.0 credits: compare table says ~7 credits/5s at 720p, plan quiz says ≈14 credits per 8s 720p; both approximate
  • Krea Max plan per-clip counts: count column appears to assume a 40k pack, price for that pack not shown; Max omitted
  • Kling 4.0: official API page lists per-second rates, but input video changes the billed duration, so no single $/s is in the table

How do we calculate this?

Every dollar figure on this page comes from the price rows when the site is built. API rows use the vendor's stated dollars per second. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and assumes every credit you pay for is used. A promo shows its end date. An approximate row is one the vendor marked with "~", "roughly", or "estimated". The full method is on the about page (https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/about/).
